reviews.author: Robert Lenzo
reviews.text: Our family of six recently got into an accident on I-95 by the South Carolina border near Hardeeville. We were heading up North for a couple weeks with our 4 kids and a lot of luggage! With very little service (can only make calls that were breaking up) all we had was AAA and their local services which take hours and won’t bring your car to a local shop (only to their designated storage areas). We called Jason’s shop about an hour from closing and from the very beginning he and Mariana went above and beyond to treat us like family. We were in an unfamiliar area and in a situation which would have been easy to take advantage of. They guided us with exactly what to do and who to call to ensure our car and family were taken care of. We will forever be indebted to Jason and Mariana and are truly grateful for their help!

reviews.author: Ron Sages
reviews.text: Complete front end & front side panels on ‘08 Wrangler had to be replaced after getting hit from behind on I-16 & being pushed into flat bed truck. Damage cosmetic; not functional or operational. Initial insurance adjuster repair quote in stratosphere. Jason & his team worked miracles to repair the damage including precise matching of a non-traditional color! Easy to work with; friendly & knowledgeable! Very reasonable price to put this cherished vehicle back on the road. Highly recommend for quality body & fender restoration!

reviews.author: Robert Beeker
reviews.text: Jason just repaired my 2026 Toyota Camry the was hit in the rear. Not only did he do a great job, he got me in quickly, turned it around quickly, kept me informed through the entire process. Jason is honest and does what he says he is going to do. I hope I never need him again, but if I do, he has earned my business. He's an honest man!!!

reviews.author: Raphaella Monteiro
reviews.text: Great experience! The team was professional, friendly, and did an excellent job on my car. The service was quick and everything turned out great. I’m very happy with the results and would definitely recommend them!

reviews.author: Julia Gallo
reviews.text: If you’re looking for an auto body shop, look no further!!!! From start to finish this was by far one of the best auto body shops I’ve been to. Jason, the owner, was super professional, quick in response and the quality was flawless. They made the whole process stress free and my car came back looking better than ever 10/10 recommend !!!

reviews.author: Georgia Cassady
reviews.text: They were amazing throughout my repair process. I was involved in a minor accident and car was not drivable. They got my repairs done faster than initially expected and so nice with every interaction, great communication. Would definitely recommend! My car looks amazing after the repairs and thankful for their team!

reviews.author: Andrea Martenson
reviews.text: Jason and his team have been amazing to work with. They did body work on my car due to a motor vehicle accident. . Jason has been professional and honest. I could not have asked for a better experience

reviews.author: Tami Patoine
reviews.text: I did a really stupid thing and had a twofer car accident. I was so upset but Jason made it all work out amazingly. He is a fantastic person to do business with. I would highly recommend his shop. Being a female needing auto work is always a gamble, he was beyond fair.

reviews.author: Bladactania
reviews.text: Had a small accident in parking lot that put a pretty deep dent in both driver's side doors. Insurance was paying for it. Got an estimate here and ended up choosing this place because of good reviews. I can see why they've got them. Not only did the shop communicate with the other parties and us to make sure we were all on the same page, but we're also accommodating with drop off and pick up days/times. Friendly people, good service, great work, and they even ran my car through the car wash when they were done. Couldn't be happier!

reviews.author: Walter Baxter
reviews.text: No Limits is the premier auto body shop of the lowcountry. Excellent work, superior knowledge and attention to detail. These are good people with honest answers that you won't get anywhere else. I have been using this shop for years and I am always pleased and impressed with their work. You can't go wrong with this shop!

reviews.author: abraham RUBIO CASTILLO
reviews.text: I hit a deer, and I started to search for a collision center who could help to repair my car at Bluffton or near the area. I went to 3 places, at the first one they said that couldn’t handle it because it was a brand new car from México and Volkswagen didn’t allow them to buy original parts for it. The 2nd place was charging me 33% more than what I actually paid, and they didn’t look at the car and explain to me exactly what they would do to repair it or what parts they were needing. When I got to Jason, wife and the incredible Staff, they checked the car in detail and told me they would call me. After 1 week, Jason called me and said that since the car was from México, the job wasn’t easy because he had to find all the parts from many different places but he accepted the challenge to help me and so he did it. They just took 2 weeks to repair the car, they matched the color perfectly, it looks like if nothing had happen to my car. I recommend them 100%.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Compton
reviews.text: I was really upset when somebody bumped into my car & messed up my paint pretty good. But Jason & his team made it look like nothing even happened!! They also got it done really quickly, Im recommending this shop to all my friends

reviews.author: Chris Bilbro
reviews.text: Tier 1 body shop. You never see 5 star body shops so this says a lot. They went above and beyond handling the repairs to my truck and did it fast. Highly recommend them won’t use any other body shop in the low country. Before and after of a deer accident.

reviews.author: Mark Gadson
reviews.text: Jason and his team are not just good at what they do but they are good people. I have used their services twice and they did a great job both times. Thank you for a job well done..

reviews.author: Breanna Friedly
reviews.text: I can not thank Jason and his team enough for making my baby look brand new again. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND them to anyone.! Fast, communication is on point, reasonable, amazing work. Thank you.!

reviews.author: James King
reviews.text: Jason and his team Really fixed up some paint issues on my 2016 Ford Mustang GT. The repainted areas seamlessly blend back in with the original paint and it looks good as new. I would highly recommend using No Limit Autobody II For any of your car needs.

reviews.author: Bill Bates
reviews.text: Phenomenal Service and Repair! An unfortunate incident while I left my tailgate down and backing up a trailer left me with a damaged new truck. The crew from No Limit Auto Body II was amazing and got my work truck back on the road in under 2 weeks! My tailgate looks brand new! Thank you No Limit Auto Body II

reviews.author: Chrissy Mozeleski
reviews.text: I can’t recommend this auto body shop enough! Jason and his team went above and beyond to help me with something that wasn’t your typical service request, and they did it with zero hesitation and genuine kindness. I often feel intimidated asking for help with things I don’t fully understand, especially when it comes to my truck. I walked in feeling super stressed, but Jason’s warm and welcoming demeanor instantly put me at ease. The entire team was helpful and professional. It’s rare to find a place where you’re treated with such compassion and care, and this experience reminded me how much that matters. I’ll absolutely be returning for all my future auto needs. Highly, highly recommend!

reviews.author: Kevin Toqe
reviews.text: Jason and his team there are so accommodating and helpful. They restored my vehicle to brand new where it had been in a hit-and-run. He made the process smooth, and he was trustworthy the whole way through it.

reviews.author: Richard Feldsztain
reviews.text: Best auto body, I will highly recommend to everyone they are very Profesional, really good customer service and excellent work. Thank again!!

reviews.author: Matthew Sturtevant
reviews.text: Superior service all around. Excellent quality work, done on-time and within budget. If you need repair, 100% recommend their shop.

reviews.author: Lynn Price
reviews.text: Totally recommend No Limit Auto Body II. Very pleased with the repairs to my Honda Accord. Jason communicated well and kept me informed of the status of the repairs.

reviews.author: Jim Matts
reviews.text: No limit two: effort 100%+, communication 110%+, willingness to go the extra mile outstanding. My wife and I cannot say enough good things about Jason ,his wife and the staff at no limit two. We “HIGHLY” recommend them for all you body shop needs!

reviews.author: Herney Satizabal
reviews.text: Just brought my car to Jason Rodriguez and had my bumper and trunk painted in my Tesla and you can’t tell was ever damaged. He always does a great job. Mariana Rodriguez Customer service is A+ friendly and professional and honest.

reviews.author: Dr. Jason B. Jones
reviews.text: Yesterday, my daughter was involved in a situation on I-95 while driving 12 hours to Florida. She was forced to run over a tire at a high rate of speed. This effected her wheel well. Needless to say she was a little freaked out. She found No limit and they got her right in. They fixed her up fast and got her on the road. Professional and fast.

reviews.author: MyrtleIslandZ71
reviews.text: No limit autobody 2 is a great shop! They painted and prepped my two bumpers for my jeep with a textured black coating. It is strong and looks tough. I will continue to use the shop for a lot of my modifications for my jeep truck. Very easy process the owner is very involved and ensures everything that comes out is top quality. Give them a call you will not be disappointed!

reviews.author: Brandon Cooler
reviews.text: Jason and his crew did an amazing job on my bike. Friendly, helpful, and a quick turn around. I highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Sarah Stewart
reviews.text: We were trying to decide on where to take my car to have it repaired and my son recommended No Limit Auto Body II. We took my Honda Accord there and met with Jason and his wife Mariana. Immediately, I knew this is where I wanted my car to be repaired. They along with their staff were highly professional and knowledgeable. They told me when to bring my car in and when it would be done. Like they stated, my car would be done in 5 days. It was done in 5 days. My car turned out great, and I'm extremely satisfied. Great customer service and very extremely efficient. FIVE STARS!!!! Thank you Jason (Jrod),Mariana and staff for your work.

reviews.author: Lynn Blahuta
reviews.text: This team is wonderful. They did an excellent job on my body repairs. Their pricing was fair and far below other estimates. In addition, shortly after the work someone noticed my brake light out, I wasn’t sure if it was due to repair loosing a wire.. it was a burned out bulb.. they found that and replaced it at no charge. Great company!

reviews.author: Don Seehausen
reviews.text: My wife’s vehicle, a 2012 Kia Optima, had a collision that seriously damaged her left rear quarter panel and rear bumper. Jason did a remarkable job fixing it in “like new” condition. Beautiful paint job, fare exceeding our expectations. Work completed over a few weeks, but ahead of schedule. I can’t not give enough praises and compliments to Jason, Mariana and his extraordinary body detail team. Simply the BEST!

reviews.author: Amy Hughes
reviews.text: I couldn’t be happier with Jason at No Limit Auto Body II. He rescued me from my own stupidity fixing my dangling bumper and didn’t charge me a dime! I highly recommend him and No Limit II for your car repair needs!

reviews.author: Reilly Lancaster
reviews.text: My experience was so pleasant. The owners were easy to work with. They quickly ordered parts and repaired the trim on one side of my car. The workers were quick and very kind. I had to bring my baby with me and the owner was so accommodating to let him play in the office while the car was being repaired. I definitely will be back.

reviews.author: Cinthia Memije
reviews.text: Today started off rough as I found out my car was keyed yesterday. On top of that, I was struggling to find an auto body shop to get me in before June just for an estimate. I called and Mariana asked me to stop by today if possible. They took a look at it and were able to fix it today. I am extremely thankful and I will definitely be using this business again. They were extremely professional, kind, and helpful. I will be referring to all my friends and family. Thank you so much. You guys are awesome!

reviews.author: Jim Murphy
reviews.text: Jason and Marianna operate a very fine, professional business. If you want your paint and body work done by a super great team, then take your business to NO LIMIT AUTO BODY II. Honesty and integrity is the overall backbone of this business. Take all your work to them and you’ll never need to worry about the job being done with a high degree of accuracy. I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Trista Marrotta
reviews.text: Excellent service from start to finish. They were able to get my Jeep in and have the work completed weeks before any other shop in the area was even able to offer an appointment for an estimate. Jason kept me updated constantly throughout and his wife was sweet and helpful as well. You just don't get that kind of service anymore. Highly recommend. Thanks!

reviews.author: Commodore Davy
reviews.text: I initially went to another body shop when l backed my 2015 50th Anniversary Mustang into my mail box. OUCH. This was in May. The place l went for an estimate said they were 3 months behind and earliest they could work me in was August. They gave me an estimate and l went OOPS. Told them l would get back to them. Asked my Ford dealer if there were other body shops and learned of No Limit Auto Body ll. Also Jason was a vet. I am a Vietnam vet so giving my business to a fellow vet was a plus. Jason was also backed up but said he'd work me in. 3 weeks later he worked me in and got my car back in a week. Did a great job and l didn't have to re mortgage my house. More reasonable than the other Body Shop. My neighbor asked me who repaired my Mustang. Recommended Jason and then wrote this which l have been meaning to do for some time. You won't go wrong taking your auto to his shop.

reviews.author: Raymond Martin
reviews.text: They repaired my Dad's truck and it turned out amazing. The paint work was flawless with ZERO orange peel. Great communication during the repair process and fairly priced. Will definitely use again in the future. Thanks for taking care of my Dad!!

reviews.author: Chris White
reviews.text: I cannot say enough great things about this team. Driving home at 5:00pom (on a Friday, when everyone is ready to go home) I had overheat issues. Desperately looking for water, I took a chance and walked into No Limit Auto Body II. Not only did Jason offer to let use water, He helped me troubleshoot the issue. He loaned me a few tools, gave me a couple of hose clamps and double checked my work to make sure the repair was properly completed. Again, I DID THE WORK, but he wanted to make sure when MY repair left his shop it was done properly!!! If he is that concerned over a job that he is not making a dime, Their customers must be treated like rockstars. Hands down this will be my first choice for body work after that experience.

reviews.author: Aubrey Pinckney
reviews.text: Jason and his team are knowledgeable and professional. Fast and affordable service. My husband’s truck looks fantastic after being repainted. The workmanship and attention to detail is unrivaled. Would most definitely use again.

reviews.author: Leo Faccenda
reviews.text: This shop is awesome, they were incredibly helpful from the very beginning! Not only were they able to squeeze my car into an already busy schedule but they were transparent and followed up on all the work they did. Everything looked and worked great and when I had a small problem they took my car in short notice to get it sorted out. If you have the unfortunate luck of getting in an accident requiring body work do yourself a favor and support this family owned business you will not regret it!

reviews.author: Cole Herbkersman
reviews.text: I called Jason to have a few plastic engine components painted to match my Powder coated metal ones. Anyone with experience in powder coating knows that matching a powder coat with a paint color is very very difficult. I am probably about as particular as they come when it comes to my engine bay, I can honestly say that I cant tell the difference in color. The matching was spot on. They are an absolute pleasure to work with. 10/10 would recommend. Attention to detail is key in their line of work, and they have it in spades.

reviews.author: andrew richard
reviews.text: The folks at No Limit Auto Body II saved the day for me. I had a run in with a deer that rendered my F-150 inoperable. Jason and his staff were able to get me in quickly and worked diligently to get my truck back into working condition. The truck now looks like nothing ever happened. If you have automotive body work needs, your first call needs to be No Limit Auto Body II!

reviews.author: Glacier Ice
reviews.text: Jason and his team are top-notch. We are a military family who had another veteran do our car work for years before retiring, and were referred to this former Marine and NLABII. They're patient, honest, and extremely helpful. They're also just 10 minutes from our home in New Riverside, Bluffton. We hope this young man stays around for a very long time and will always bring our work there should we ever need help again.

reviews.author: James Carmany (Aquatic Spas HHI)
reviews.text: No Limit Auto Body II provides great customer service and quality workmanship!! I highly recommend them to anyone needing their vehicle fixed.. The owner and his wife are super friendly and family oriented! If you want superb service, go to No Limit Auto Body II. In addition you would be supporting a local family run business!!

reviews.author: Tanner Barley
reviews.text: Tyler and his crew made it a priority to get my truck into service as quickly as possible. Every other body shop had a wait-list until mid April, but they took care of me within the first week of February. It was returned to me as pristine as before getting T-boned!

reviews.author: jim wetzel
reviews.text: Amazing work! I will only take my vehicles to this shop. They fixed my truck after it was hit by a drunk driver and they fixed my wife’s jeep after a deer hit it. They were professional and delivered quality work.

reviews.author: Alan Trudeau
reviews.text: Having to deal with a vehicle accident & then the autobody repairs is never a good thing. However, dealing with No Limit Auto Body was virtually painless. Jason & Marianna were wonderful to work with & they kept us informed on the progress of our vehicle repair every step of the way! They also dealt with the Insurance company, which is not an easy task for anyone! Thank you No Limit Auto Body II for a job well done!! Hopefully we will not need your services in the future.....but know that if we do you will be our first choice!

reviews.author: Mark Boles
reviews.text: They did an excellent job restoring and painting my golf cart. Their prices are very fair. The whole staff is honest and excellent to work with. Best body shop experience I’ve ever had.

reviews.author: Chelsea White
reviews.text: No Limit II was wonderful to work with! They did a phenomenal job on our car. Friendly service and would recommend them every time.

reviews.author: Bill Hinchcliffe
reviews.text: Jason and his Team are Professional and perform quality work. If you need body work and or painting on your vehicle I recommend you have Jason provide you with an estimate prior to having work performed at another business.

reviews.author: Scott Frieden
reviews.text: Jason's military and law enforcement experience carries through to this business. No Limit 2 is by far the best auto body business that I have used. The quote for cost and time completion were both spot on. You can't go wrong with No Limit autobody 2

reviews.author: Ashley Phillips
reviews.text: Window was stuck in downward position. Driving anything over 30 mph was absolutely frigid today. They got me right in when we called and fixed me up quickly! Shop and office impressively clean and work quality unmatched! Would recommend to anyone! Thanks y’all!

reviews.author: Amanda Luechtefeld
reviews.text: Within one week of our collision they had my car looking brand new. No one can tell that it had pretty heavy front damage previously. I wouldn't go to anyone else! Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Terry Harden
reviews.text: Outstanding work, great customer service and very fair price. Was very satisfied with the quality of work done to our SUV which needed a dent fixed.

reviews.author: Sol Terrazas
reviews.text: Excellent work and owners! They get the work done quick so you can get your car back, very attentive and know what they’re doing.

reviews.author: Mark S.
reviews.text: Jason Rodriquez and his team are awesome. Seriously did me a favor at no charge. Don't hesitate to use them. Trustworthy and reliable!

reviews.author: Melanie Langan
reviews.text: This shop is great! They worked directly with the insurance company and made it very easy for us! They did great work, would recommend!!

reviews.author: Mitchell Altman
reviews.text: Very professional with a high attention to detail. They beat several other quotes for my paint job and did great job!

reviews.author: God’s Precious Kargo
reviews.text: They are very professional and does really good work. They did my mom and a coworker car and did a really good job.

reviews.author: Michell Calendine
reviews.text: Great service and quality work! Very trustworthy and knows the body shop business well. Would recommend to anyone.

reviews.author: Jackie Jesus
reviews.text: Excellent, customer service and job was performed on a timely manner. Would recommend them to anyone looking for car services in the area. Thank you very much!!

reviews.author: jillienne grant
reviews.text: Jason at No Limit Auto II was so helpful and kind when my friend and I got stranded with a flat. He swapped our doughnut and got us back on the way to finishing our trip. Went above and beyond. Thank you!

reviews.author: John Clark
reviews.text: These guys did an awesome job getting my fender wells and the bumper back in place. I can't tell it had been pulled out of place

reviews.author: junior tinoco
reviews.text: Absolutely FANTASTIC service all the way around !!!! Super friendly and professional They were done just in TWO days awesome work guys Thanks . Would definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Fresh2.0 Lol
reviews.text: This place was awesome. Great staff and a great job. If I ever get another boo boo on the bang wagon I’ll be going back.

reviews.author: Marc Ricciardi
reviews.text: Awesome service and incredible work! Did what they said they would and did it when they said they would do it! Amazing service down to the last detail.

reviews.author: Lisa Kane
reviews.text: Can’t say enough good things about this place. Thank you guys for the professionalism and immaculate work.
